page.layout: One page of text: title block in centred lines, with a woodcut ornament below and the catchword at the lower right.

main_text.l: artige alte Tafel/ darin das gantze
abgemahlet wirdt/ mit nützlicher und gantze heil-

page.notes: The ornamental woodcut strip under the running head and the woodcut ornament between the title and the catchword are decoration, not text. The woodcut ornament is a decorative headpiece, not transcribed. The word "ganze" in the line "abgemahlet wirdt" is printed as "ganhe" in the scan; read as "gantze". Line "mit nützlicher und ganhe heil-" is uncertain in its final letters. The word "Bericht" at the lower right is the catchword leading to the next page.
